text: EX-053: gaps found in video-player-web draft. Please revisit: (1) src/components/Youtube.tsx — explain WHY modestbranding=1 and rel=0 are set (privacy/branding policy), document loop parameter behavior, and any interaction with platform privacy defaults; (2) src/components/SizeContainer.tsx — document which aspect ratio is the default, how designers choose among them, and what breaks if the ratio is misconfigured; (3) src/VideoPlayer.editorConfig.ts — document the constraint relationship between height and heightUnit: why height is hidden when heightUnit === 'aspectRatio' and the UX implication; (4) CHANGELOG.md — confirm whether the v3.1.1 'app navigation broken when URL changed' fix is caused by iframe not re-mounting (verify from source, not inference); (5) Overall — add explicit documentation for architectural choices: why URL-free key is used in SafeDOM, why selective prop forwarding per platform is enforced at TypeScript interface level, why HTML5 uses direct DOM ref manipulation for error state instead of React state.
